ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, if $\tan A = \frac{1}{2}$ and $AB = 10$, then what is the area of $\triangle ABC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} We have $\because \tan A=\frac{1}{2}=\frac{BC}{AC}$\\
$\therefore AC=2BC$\\
By the Pythagorean theorem, we have $AB^{2}=AC^{2}+BC^{2}$, which gives $100=(2BC)^{2}+BC^{2}$\\
Solving this, we find $BC^{2}=20$\\
$\therefore {S}_{\triangle ABC}=\frac{1}{2}AC\times BC=BC^{2}=\boxed{20}$
